
---
title: "RetailPulse Kerala - Customer Segmentation Report"
author: "Shreya S"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

# 1. Executive Summary

This report analyzes customer purchasing behaviour using RFM analysis (Recency, Frequency and Monetary). It identifies valuable customers and customers who may need retention campaigns.

# 2. Load Customer Data

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

rfm <- readRDS("../data/processed/rfm_customer_data.rds")
```

# 3. Customer Segment Summary

```{r}
segment_summary <- rfm %>%
  group_by(Segment) %>%
  summarise(
    Customers = n(),
    Total_Revenue = sum(Monetary, na.rm = TRUE),
    Average_Revenue = mean(Monetary, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(segment_summary, digits = 2)
```

# 4. Customer Distribution

```{r}
ggplot(segment_summary, aes(x = reorder(Segment, Customers), y = Customers, fill = Segment)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Customer Distribution by Segment",
    x = "Customer Segment",
    y = "Number of Customers"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# 5. Revenue by Customer Segment

```{r}
ggplot(segment_summary, aes(x = reorder(Segment, Total_Revenue), y = Total_Revenue, fill = Segment)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Revenue Contribution by Customer Segment",
    x = "Customer Segment",
    y = "Revenue"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# 6. RFM Analysis

```{r}
rfm_summary <- rfm %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Customers = n(),
    Average_Recency = mean(Recency, na.rm = TRUE),
    Average_Frequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
    Average_Monetary = mean(Monetary, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

kable(rfm_summary, digits = 2)
```

# 7. Business Insights

- Champions contribute the highest customer revenue.
- Loyal customers provide an important source of repeat business.
- At-risk customers may need targeted engagement campaigns.
- Hibernating customers can be approached with reactivation offers.
- New customers can be encouraged to make repeat purchases.

# 8. Recommendations

1. Provide loyalty rewards to Champions.
2. Create special offers for At Risk customers.
3. Use email campaigns to reconnect with Hibernating customers.
4. Encourage Potential Loyalists to purchase more frequently.
5. Build retention strategies for valuable customers.

# 9. Conclusion

RFM segmentation helps identify valuable customers and customers who may need additional attention. These insights can support targeted marketing and customer retention strategies.

**Data Limitation:** The transaction dataset covers December 2009 to December 2011. Customer recency is calculated relative to the final date in this historical dataset, not the current date.
